critical_code_review_comments: FinancialInputHub.jsx is now 1558 lines — needs splitting per tab (each tab form could be its own file under /pages/FinancialInputHub/). The pickLiability handler is now ~40 lines with virtual-branch logic, but it's well-commented and the pendingTopup pattern is sound.

Good defensive design: `selected = openLiabilities.find(...) || pendingTopup`. This guarantees the form always has access to the just-created topup row regardless of when the parent's openLiabilities refetch lands. On submit success, pendingTopup is cleared so subsequent searches use the fresh openLiabilities.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Scenario C is fully fixed. The salary-topup virtual-entry flow is end-to-end functional: (1) employee with fully-paid current month liability + positive net_due appears as a virtual entry with the pay-liability-virtual-badge testid; (2) clicking it POSTs /liabilities/salary-topup and stores the response in pendingTopup local state — form.liability_id is set and the search input shows created.description ('راتب مستحق إضافي — <name>'); (3) the selected balance card renders because `selected` getter falls back to pendingTopup; (4) submit fires POST /api/liabilities/{topup_id}/pay successfully and resets pendingTopup + form. Use [data-testid='hub-tab-pay-liab'] to switch tab (label text is 'سداد التزام', not 'سداد الالتزام'). Setup steps via API are reliable.
rca of the issue: Iter-51 root cause: After clicking the virtual entry, pickLiability called set('liability_id', created.id), setQuery(...), and then onSaved() — the onSaved triggered the parent's load() which refetched openLiabilities and re-rendered PayLiabilityForm, wiping the just-set local state. FIX (iter-52): (1) introduced `pendingTopup` local state (line 251) that holds the just-created topup row independent of openLiabilities; (2) `selected` getter (line 253-254) falls back to pendingTopup when form.liability_id matches; (3) REMOVED the onSaved() call from the virtual branch (lines 425-456) — comment explicitly states 'We deliberately DO NOT call onSaved() here'; (4) submit() (line 489-491) clears pendingTopup + form + query AFTER a successful payment, then calls onSaved() so the parent refresh now happens at the correct time. Verified end-to-end: POST /api/liabilities/salary-topup → POST /api/liabilities/{topup_id}/pay both fire successfully in the same UI session.
